configurePresets.name: windows-debug
configurePresets.description: Builds outside the repo under C:/b -- this project's own deeply nested DiligentEngine/glslang source paths combined with this repo's own path length exceed Windows' 260-char MAX_PATH when built in-tree (e.g. the default out/build/<preset> location). See CLAUDE.md for the full story. Works from Visual Studio's/VS Code's own 'Open Folder' CMake integration or plain `cmake --preset windows-debug`.

configurePresets.name: windows-relwithdebinfo
configurePresets.displayName: Windows RelWithDebInfo (Ninja, short build dir, fast + debuggable)
configurePresets.description: Optimized build with debug symbols -- the config to pick from Visual Studio's own configuration dropdown when you want to run/debug interactively without paying Debug's _ITERATOR_DEBUG_LEVEL=2 tax (this project measured that tax at ~80x for concurrent hash-map-heavy code; see mesh_extractor.cpp's NeighborCache comment and CLAUDE.md). Release remains the near-zero-compromise choice when raw speed matters most.
